hook: GHMC trade licences: renew by *Nov 30* or pay up to 100% penalty
hook_b: GHMC trade licences: renew by *Nov 30* or pay up to 100% penalty
tldr: GHMC Commissioner R.V. Karnan said on Nov 20 that 2026 trade licences stay valid until Dec 31, 2026, but 2027 renewals filed by Nov 30 carry no penalty. Late renewals from Dec 1 attract 25%, and from Feb 1, 2027, 50%.

beats.what: Shops and businesses inside GHMC limits must renew 2027 trade licences by Nov 30 to avoid penalties.
beats.why: Renewals must be filed in the 30-day window before the licence expires on Dec 31.
beats.care: Miss the date and the fee rises by 25% to 50%; no licence at all means a 100% penalty.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today (Nov 20): 2026 licences stay valid until Dec 31, 2026, but the penalty-free renewal window closes Nov 30.

cards.q: Should GHMC send renewal reminders by SMS to every licence holder?

qs: How many GHMC businesses renew late each year?
Can small vendors renew online without an agent?

facts.t: Trading without a valid licence draws a *100%* penalty plus an extra *10%* fine every month.

viz.verdict: Penalty rises the later traders renew

learn.t: Trade licence = GHMC permission every shop or business needs to operate legally

watch: Whether GHMC extends the Nov 30 penalty-free window, as traders often ask.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: GHMC asks traders to renew 2027 trade licences by November 30 to avoid penalties

fact: GHMC traders have until *Nov 30* to renew 2027 trade licences penalty-free
twist: Running a shop with no valid licence costs a 100% penalty, plus 10% more every month until it is renewed.
